verdict.note: Real Chromium 1280x800 over this worktree's Vite + live :8787, Notion chosen via the real Settings picker: Minimal hovered .ft-row bg color(srgb .82 .82 .82/.08)=--wash-hover, rail .on bg =--wash-selected, Tab-focused rail-btn box-shadow inset 2px ring + outline none; Notion the same three reads resolve to rgba(55,53,47,.08), rgba(35,131,226,.14), inset rgba(35,131,226,.45) — same rules, different token values.

Re-measured at the merged tip: Minimal hovered row color(srgb .82/.08)=--wash-hover, rail .on =--wash-selected, focused rail-btn inset ring + outline none; Notion the same reads resolve to rgba(55,53,47,.08), rgba(35,131,226,.14), inset rgba(35,131,226,.45).

Pre-change tree, all nine presets fail. In minimal/tokyonight/everforest/gruvbox/dracula the right-click menu, the session list and the terminal pane resolve to ONE value (menu L* == terminal L* == sidebar L*, e.g. minimal 12.7/12.7/12.7): the menu has no fill boundary against the pane it was opened over, only the half-strength --edge hairline at ~1.3:1 and a drop that moves a near-black pixel 1-4 L*. Catppuccin is the same defect 3.4 L* apart. In things/notion the menu is the sidebar's own value; rosepine additionally runs its ladder backwards (sidebar 98.5 ABOVE plane 96.5) because it carries Dawn's elevated 'surface' as chrome.

Same nine presets on the fixed tree, all pass. The ladder climbs one way everywhere: minimal terminal 9.8 / sidebar 12.7 / plane 15.2 / menu 23.1; gruvbox 7.6/12.0/16.1/24.0; everforest 16.6/19.8/24.8/31.7. Dark presets lift the menu 6.9-8.6 L* off the plane and 10.4-12.1 off the sidebar, and 13.3-16.4 off the terminal. Light presets sit the menu at their lightest value and carry the lift with the drop (things/notion 100 on a 100 plane, rosepine 98.5 on 96.5) — the palette has no headroom left, which is the documented split. Every xterm screen paints exactly the value the sheet resolves for --term-bg. Read through the real dashboard against the live backend, on a live session's Terminal tab, with the menu summoned over the sidebar/terminal boundary.

Re-measured on #/spec under Minimal and Notion, both chosen through the real Settings picker. Every token is resolved through a probe element so both sides of each comparison carry the same serialization — comparing a computed color() against the declared color-mix() text is a false negative, which is what my first run produced. An Explorer row is transparent at rest in both presets (pointer parked off the tree first: leaving it over the row from the previous pass reads a hover as 'rest'), the hovered row's background equals the resolved --wash-hover EXACTLY in both, the lit rail equals --wash-selected exactly in both, and a focused rail entry wears the inset ring with outline:none. Minimal derives its three from the palette, Notion resolves flat greys and a blue ring; the rules consuming them are the same. Unchanged by the ladder work, which added a rung above the plane and touched no interaction token.

RE-ANCHORED after syncing main. main had moved 36 commits and folded packages/terminal-ui into spec-dashboard/src/terminal, touching five of the files this branch changed — styles.css among them — so the previous pass was anchored to a tree that no longer exists. Re-driven through the real dashboard on the synced tree, all nine presets pass unchanged: minimal terminal 9.8 / sidebar 12.7 / plane 15.2 / menu 23.1; gruvbox 7.6/12.0/16.1/24.0; everforest 16.6/19.8/24.8/31.7. Dark presets lift the menu 6.9-8.6 L* off the plane and 13.3-16.4 off the terminal; light presets sit it at their lightest value with the drop carrying the lift. Every xterm screen still paints exactly the sheet's --term-bg after the relocation. Also checked rather than assumed across the sync: all 37 --raised declarations survive, :root still resolves --term-bg to var(--ground), and no floating surface added by those 36 commits sits off the raised rung.
